budget_items.what_was_recorded: The pump on Squad 3 may need repair or replacement sooner, at a cost within the total project.
budget_items.quote: at a cost of $15,000 of the $65,000 total project.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Some portable radios have been purchased for new officers, out of a total line.
budget_items.quote: portable radios some have been purchased for new officers - $2,000 of the $45,000

budget_items.topic: State infrastructure bond bill projects for Lunenburg
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Two of four Lunenburg projects were chosen in the bond bill: turnout gear for the LFD and fire alarm upgrades at the Primary School.
budget_items.quote: projects chosen - $150,000 turn out gear for the lfd and $100,000 fire alarm upgrades at the primary school

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A regional block grant application, approved, will provide funds for microloans for small businesses and to support local food banks.
budget_items.quote: $296,100 for microloans for small businesses and to support local food banks.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Eligibility for the microloans was described as businesses with five or fewer employees and no more than a stated amount; documents had not been issued.
budget_items.quote: businesses with 5 or less employees and no more than $10,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Capital Planning projects were said to be starting to add up to over a stated total.
budget_items.quote: starting to add up to over $6m in capital planning projects.

budget_items.topic: DESE COVID-related grants to the school department
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The school department received two COVID-related grants from DESE, to fund stipends, PPE, custodial overtime, substitutes, and related costs.
A one-year teacher contract with minor language change and some financial impact: no COLA, with a 0.5% increase after 90 days for top-step teachers (85 teachers); cost associated.
budget_items.quote: with some financial impact - no cola increase a .5% increase after 90 days
